d: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang has reportedly become the focus of a Chinese espionage investigation, with US intelligence agencies suspecting that a Chinese businesswoman with close access to him was working for Beijing. The allegations raise serious questions about China's efforts to access advanced AI chips, bypass US export restrictions and gather sensitive corporate intelligence. With Donald Trump, Nvidia's China business and America's AI ambitions in the picture, the stakes extend far beyond Silicon Valley.
